g.text: Jika N(t) = N_0 . a^t maka untuk mencari WAKTU t gunakan logaritma:

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #f8fafc

g.text: t = log_a (N(t) / N_0) | Contoh: 2^t = 32 <==> t = log_2(32) = 5 periode

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #f8fafc

g.text: Sifat Penting: log_a(X . Y) = log_a(X) + log_a(Y) | log_a(X^k) = k . log_a(X)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #fbbf24
